lines: Your feet kicked the moon
The white sand looks like a night lamp
I wonder if you realize it
Something lay beyond the waves
I didn’t know what it was
A little lonely
Adding, adding, it overflows
Adding, adding, the more we add, the more passes
We walked together along the night sea
The bundles of moon look like icy rain
I wonder if you realize it
Something hid in the crack of the rock
I didn’t know what it was
A little painful
Adding, adding, layering
Adding, adding, the more we add, the more passes
Days lived within the moon
Someone called them months and days
We who spend time inside the moon
One could call it moon‑bathing
Waiting for the waves, stepping over the moon
Our bodies are as white as night lamps
Adding, adding, we forget
Adding, adding, on the growing days we increase
Our feet kicked the water
Our dorsal fins glowed and flickered
Are we swimming, I wonder
I, a fish, took a breath
You finally noticed too
The moon is dazzling
